description: Call this when the user asks for reviews, testimonials, opinions or whether Kanal Varna is good/reliable. Returns ONLY real reviews: customer video reviews (with what the customer says and the video URL) and any approved text reviews from the website. There is deliberately no aggregate star rating — do not invent one.

language.description: Language of the user's question: 'bg' (Bulgarian), 'en' (English), 'ru' (Russian) or 'de' (German; answers use English labels where no German text exists). If omitted it is detected from the text; default 'bg'.
language.title: Language
